findings.title: Keep the worker’s existing front door
findings.observation: The public product emphasizes familiar messaging.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Let staff report through the authorized WhatsApp connection first. Add the SupaBiz app when it improves capture, offline queues or receipts. A low-friction interface still needs organization enrollment, current staff grants, business/outlet identity and revocation. A phone number or group membership alone is not sufficient authority for purchases, payroll or broad data access.
findings.measure: Report completion rate; time to first useful report; identity errors; onboarding effort.

findings.title: Capture now; ask the smallest missing question
findings.observation: The recorded demo starts with a brief equipment report.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Acknowledge receipt without claiming resolution. Resolve the likely outlet and asset from authorized context, then ask one focused question if needed. During service, do not force staff through a long form. Let them answer by voice, text or a quick choice. Persist incomplete reports with a visible owner and status so unanswered questions do not erase the issue.
findings.measure: Time to report; clarification turns; abandoned reports; unresolved ambiguity age.

findings.title: Voice should preserve meaning across languages
findings.observation: Voice and multilingual input are advertised.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Support the languages and code-switching actually used by Varun’s staff; test kitchen noise. Store original audio, time-aligned transcript and translation separately under retention policy. Confirm critical units, numbers, asset and negation, not every word. Offer short text acknowledgement and optional read-aloud; keep transcripts editable. Do not infer worker identity or emotion from voice.
findings.measure: Critical-field error rate; negation/unit errors; correction effort; language-specific task success.

findings.title: Photos should anchor a report to visible evidence
findings.supabiz_proposal: Link each observation to the original image and relevant crop or box. A spill, damaged seal or delivery label can support a report, but a photo cannot establish hidden temperature, food safety or repair success. Ask for a wider view, close-up or readable label only when needed. Distinguish observed, worker-reported and model-inferred facts.
findings.measure: Correct issue/location identification; unsupported visual claims; requests for retakes; evidence availability.

findings.title: Use video for sequence and movement
findings.observation: Video input is advertised; its processing internals are unknown.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Use short clips for recurring leaks, moving equipment or a chef’s demonstration. Analyze audio and time-linked visual segments together; retain timestamps. Begin with bounded sampling and request closer examination for uncertain moments. Never infer absence of a brief event from sparse frames. Separate live issue evidence from tutorial capture, and require review before a demonstrated procedure becomes a published SOP.
findings.measure: Temporal-event recall; unsupported conclusions; reviewer effort; cost per useful clip.

findings.title: Resolve the outlet, area and asset explicitly
findings.observation: Public examples connect reports to equipment.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Maintain Consu/ForeFathers → outlet → area → asset identifiers and scoped aliases. A QR label can prefill the asset in the SupaBiz app; it is a locator, not an access credential. Resolve fridge near the back using the current authorized outlet; ask when multiple assets match. Keep original worker wording and any inferred association.
findings.measure: Wrong-outlet routing; wrong-asset tasks; duplicate incidents; clarification frequency.

findings.title: Return a work receipt and close the loop
findings.observation: Work-order routing appears in the public material.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Reply with a short issue ID, confirmed location, what was understood, current owner and next status. Track received, needs clarification, assigned, accepted, in progress, blocked, submitted and verified closed. A sent notification is not an accepted assignment. A before/after photo supports review but must not automatically prove physical repair or sanitation.
findings.measure: Report-to-acceptance time; unowned issues; verified resolution; reopen rate.

findings.title: Give managers an exception queue
findings.observation: The recorded demo shows filters for manager attention and unassigned work.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Give the outlet manager Needs attention, Unassigned, Waiting, Due this shift and Needs verification views. Varun receives a cross-business summary with a clear outlet label on every item. Bundle routine updates; escalate urgent issues under approved policies. Shift handover carries open work, accepted owner, blocker and evidence rather than another long chat recap.
findings.measure: Manager interruptions; age of blockers; handover omissions; alert acknowledgement.

findings.title: Answer from approved local procedures
findings.supabiz_proposal: Return a concise answer with the relevant approved SOP version and a link to the exact page or clip time. Use retrieval filters for outlet, asset model, role and validity dates. Do not mix a different business’s recipe, allergen procedure or maintenance instruction into a confident answer. Missing or contradictory guidance should go to the designated manager.
findings.measure: Evidence-backed answer rate; outdated-SOP answers; unsupported instructions; escalation precision.

findings.title: Capture a verified fix as candidate knowledge
findings.observation: The product advertises memory of resolutions and manager answers.
findings.supabiz_proposal: After a verified resolution, draft a knowledge entry with problem, asset, symptoms, evidence, authorized resolver and conditions. Ask whether it applies once, to this asset, this outlet or an approved organization-wide pattern. Do not learn a general rule from every message or repeat an unsafe workaround. Link to SB-AS-13 and generate a reviewed Hue-style regression case.
findings.measure: Repeat incident rate; unsafe generalization; knowledge freshness; regression coverage.

findings.title: Version and retire procedures
findings.observation: The demo shows New Version and Deprecate controls.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Let an authorized chef or manager record a short training walkthrough. Produce a draft checklist with timestamped steps and missing-information flags. A reviewer approves scope, translations and version before publishing. Staff acknowledgement and demonstrated competence are separate events; video viewed is not certification. Retire superseded instructions while retaining historical provenance.
findings.measure: Training completion with checks; outdated content retrieval; reviewer correction rate; ramp-up time.

findings.title: Share knowledge between outlets deliberately
findings.supabiz_proposal: Varun owning two businesses does not make all information interchangeable. Default to business/outlet scope. Offer an explicit approved template-sharing action with equipment/procedure applicability checks. Reuse generic issue categories or approved process templates while keeping customer, staff, supplier, financial and business-specific knowledge appropriately separated.
findings.measure: Cross-business leaks; wrong-equipment advice; useful approved reuse; template update propagation.

findings.title: Treat sensor evidence separately from visual inference
findings.supabiz_proposal: Later, ingest approved refrigerator/asset telemetry with device identity, calibrated units, timestamp and freshness. Distinguish measured temperature from a staff report and a photographed display. Missing sensor data is unknown, not normal. Do not copy predictive-maintenance claims without sufficient telemetry and validation. Start with issue reporting before buying hardware or promising prediction.
findings.measure: Sensor freshness; false alerts; missed events; measured downtime; review burden.

findings.title: Make staff trust and operational value visible
findings.observation: Privacy describes employer access to some usage information.
findings.supabiz_proposal: Tell staff what is recorded, who can see reports and how to correct them. Use targeted operational capture, not continuous surveillance or inferred worker scoring. Minimize bystander/customer media, restrict sensitive details, and propagate retention/deletion to transcripts, thumbnails and test copies. Measure correct completed work and staff effort before claiming productivity gains.
findings.measure: Staff adoption; privacy incidents; verified completion cost; correction time; report quality.
